title: The Luis Russell band under Armstrong
summary: He clarifies that he joined Armstrong's band, which was Russell's band.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I remember Greeley telling me how he used to ride Higgy all the time. He used to ride Higgy so bad it would make him cry and that was in the Luis Russell band.
But I was in the Luis Russell band too.
After Louis Armstrong took it over.
You mean you were in his band before--
No, I was in the band after Louis Armstrong took it over.
But it was under Louie? In other words, you didn't join Russell's band, you joined Louie's band?
That's what I thought. You threw me a little curve there.
